portal_hypertension.title: Development of a retinal vascular nomogram for predicting hepatitis B virus-related cirrhosis: insights into extrahepatic microcirculatory dysfunctions.
portal_hypertension.authors: Huang X, Wang H, Hu J
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究（样本量约为 328）。核心观点：多变量逻辑回归确定了 HBC 的独立视网膜预测因子，并构建了列线图。 临床提示：乙型肝炎病毒相关性肝硬化（HBC）的进展以显着的肝内和肝外微血管改变和功能障碍为特征。
portal_hypertension.abstract: The progression of hepatitis B virus-related cirrhosis (HBC) is characterized by notable intrahepatic and extrahepatic microvascular alterations and dysfunctions. The retinal vasculature offers a noninvasive window to assess systemic microcirculation. This cross-sectional study aimed to evaluate retinal microcirculatory alterations in HBC and develop a retinal vascular nomogram for diagnosing HBC. We included 328 participants from two medical centers between March 2019 and October 2022. Multivariate logistic regression identified independent retinal predictors of HBC, and a nomogram was constructed. portal_hypertension.title: Decoding liver injury in cystic fibrosis: How to tell drug-induced liver injury from cystic fibrosis liver disease.
portal_hypertension.authors: Lee J, Yekula A, Wexler A
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于综述研究。核心观点：囊性纤维化肝病 (CFLD) 是囊性纤维化 (CF) 患者的一种重要合并症，以胆道纤维化和进行性胆汁淤积为特征。 临床提示：CF 跨膜电导调节剂 (CFTR) 调节剂的出现彻底改变了肺部疾病的护理，但其对肝脏特异性疾病和结果的影响仍不清楚。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Cystic fibrosis liver disease (CFLD) is a significant comorbidity in individuals with cystic fibrosis (CF), marked by biliary fibrosis and progressive cholestasis. The advent of CF transmembrane conductance regulator (CFTR) modulators has revolutionized care for lung disease, but their impact on liver-specific disease and outcomes remain unclear. Additionally, the risk of comorbid cholestatic liver injury from medications and progression of CFLD complicates the diagnostic landscape. To provide a clinical framework for differentiating CFLD and drug induced liver injury (DILI), including from CFTR modulators. A comprehensive literature review was conducted using PubMed, EMBASE, and Cochrane Li...

portal_hypertension.title: Exploratory 4D Flow MRI Study of Portal Venous Rotational Flow for High-Risk Esophageal Varices in Cirrhosis.
portal_hypertension.journal: Journal of magnetic resonance imaging : JMRI
portal_hypertension.authors: Park S, Man Moon C, Kwon M
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究（样本量约为 48）。核心观点：食管静脉曲张（EV）的出血风险评估通常在肝硬化中进行。 临床提示：使用四维血流 MRI 作为支持临床风险评估的无创方法，研究与肝硬化患者 EV 严重程度相关的门静脉血流动力学和血管几何形状。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Bleeding risk assessment of esophageal varices (EVs) is commonly performed in liver cirrhosis. However, existing approaches are often invasive or insufficient to fully capture bleeding risk. To investigate portal venous hemodynamics and vessel geometry associated with EVs severity in cirrhotic patients using four-dimensional flow MRI as a noninvasive approach to support clinical risk assessment. Retrospective. One-hundred and four cirrhotic patients consisting of patients without EVs (Group 1, n = 48), with low-risk EVs (Group 2, n = 37), and high-risk EVs (Group 3, n = 19). 3 T, a three-directional, velocity-encoded gradient echo sequence with Cartesian k-space sampling. portal_hypertension.title: Evaluation of a 3,5-diethoxycarbonyl-1,4-dihydrocollidine diet-induced mouse model in a comparative experimental study of portal hypertension.
portal_hypertension.authors: Zhao JB, Wu ZH, Lin JY
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究。核心观点：门脉高压（PHT）是慢性肝病的一种危及生命的并发症，需要模拟其临床异质性的可靠动物模型。 临床提示：胆管结扎 (BDL) 等经典小鼠模型的 4 周存活率较低 (35%)，而四氯化碳 (CCl 4 ) 模型的发病机制延迟，PHT 发展需要 ≥ 8 周，限制了其效率
portal_hypertension.abstract: Portal hypertension (PHT) is a life-threatening complication of chronic liver disease, necessitating reliable animal models that mimic its clinical heterogeneity. Classical mouse models like bile duct ligation (BDL) exhibit a low 4-week survival (35%), while carbon tetrachloride (CCl 4 ) models have delayed pathogenesis, requiring ≥ 8 weeks for PHT development, limiting their efficiency. To evaluate the 3,5-diethoxycarbonyl-1,4-dihydrocollidine (DDC) diet-induced mouse model as a biliary PHT model, comparing it to BDL and CCl 4 models.
